objective: Unify the version type, application characteristic, and status columns as compact semantic tags without changing business behavior.
users: Configuration-management users scanning the release application list

requirements.statement: All three columns must use compact tags with consistent dimensions and alignment.
acceptance: Version type, application characteristic, and status render through UiStatusTag
Tags share the same height, typography, radius, and cell alignment
requirements.source: User selected option one after reviewing the three-column screenshot.
counterexample: One of the three columns uses a different tag size

requirements.statement: Existing semantic colors for version type and status must remain unchanged.
acceptance: Regular, urgent, and emergency versions retain info, warning, and danger tones
Draft, in-review, released, returned, and withdrawn statuses retain their existing tones
requirements.source: Existing ReleaseApplicationView mappings and confirmed option-one design.
counterexample: A new color mapping is introduced

requirements.statement: Application characteristic must display either Ordinary Application or Additional Application as a semantic tag.
acceptance: Ordinary applications display 普通申请 with info tone
Additional applications display 追加申请 with warning tone
requirements.source: User selected the unified semantic-tag option.
counterexample: Ordinary remains displayed as 普通 bare text
Both characteristic values use the same warning tone

requirements.statement: The presentation change must not alter release application data or behavior.
acceptance: No API, state, filter, permission, or backend files change

invariants: Existing version and status tone functions remain unchanged
constraints: Modify only the release application list presentation
Reuse UiStatusTag and existing Element Plus semantic tones
Remain on rokey and do not commit or push
non_goals: Change detail pages or other release views
Add new status types or filters

selected_approach.name: Unified semantic tags
selected_approach.reason: It provides the strongest scanning consistency while reusing the existing component and color mappings.

alternatives.name: Layered tag treatments
alternatives.rejected_because: It introduces a second local visual rule for application characteristics.

alternatives.name: Muted ordinary text
alternatives.rejected_because: It preserves the current text-versus-tag inconsistency.

components.name: ReleaseApplicationView
components.responsibility: Render the three table semantics with consistent compact tags.

components.name: UiStatusTag
components.responsibility: Provide existing small plain semantic-tag presentation.

interfaces.name: Release application row presentation
interfaces.contract: Presentation mappings do not mutate row data or request state.

transitions: Map values to existing labels and semantic tones
data_flows.output: Aligned semantic labels in the release application list

error_handling.behavior: Render 普通申请 with info tone, matching current fallback semantics.

error_handling.condition: The longer ordinary label approaches the column width
error_handling.behavior: Keep the existing compact tag and column width; verify it remains single-line.
error_handling.recovery: Increase only the affected column width if browser evidence proves clipping.

performance: One existing lightweight tag component per row adds no meaningful cost
compatibility: No API, state, or saved-data changes
operations: No migration, configuration, or deployment changes

verification_strategy.signal: All three columns use aligned small tags with the confirmed labels and tones.
verification_strategy.method: Source assertion and authenticated browser inspection of representative rows.

verification_strategy.signal: Frontend compiles and no behavioral files change.
verification_strategy.method: npm production build, scoped diff audit, and git diff check.

assumptions.text: The requested overall design applies only to the three columns shown in the release application list screenshot.
assumptions.basis: The user explicitly referenced the left and right neighboring columns.
assumptions.falsifier: The user requests the same treatment on detail or analytics pages.

decisions.decision: Use the unified semantic-tag approach for all three columns.
decisions.reason: It removes mixed text and tag presentation while preserving semantic colors.

decisions.decision: Display 普通申请 instead of 普通.
decisions.reason: It is symmetric with 追加申请 and clearer as a characteristic label.

risks.risk: 普通申请 uses more horizontal space than 普通.
risks.impact: The 100px characteristic column could become visually tight.
risks.mitigation: Use the existing small tag and verify single-line fit in the browser.

approval.evidence: The user selected option one for the integrated three-column design on 2026-08-20.
